title: Cyber Risk and Attack Path Schema
description: A schema for representing cyber risk, attack paths, threat actors, and courses of action.

stixAttackPattern.description: A STIX 2.1 Attack Pattern object, used to represent techniques from frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.

courseOfAction.description: A course of action or mitigation that combines the STIX standard definition with internal details about its implementation, cost, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for this course of action.

cost.description: Estimated and actual costs for the mitigation.

projectedImplementation.description: The date and time when the course of action is projected to be implemented.

actualImplementation.description: The date and time when the course of action was actually implemented.

mitigatesVulnerabilities.description: A list of specific vulnerabilities that this course of action mitigates.

controlReference.description: A reference to one or more internal security controls that implement this course of action.

susceptibility.description: A potential weakness in a system that could be exploitable but is not yet confirmed as directly exploitable.

title.description: Title or short name of the susceptibility.

items.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software

associatedComponents.description: Components potentially affected by this susceptibility.

externalReferences.description: External references or documentation links related to the susceptibility.

falsePositiveJustification.description: A justification or reasoning as to why this susceptibility is not a vulnerability.

title.description: Title or short name of the vulnerability.

exploitabilityScore.description: Score indicating the ease of exploitation.

exploitedInterfaces.description: System interfaces potentially exploited by this vulnerability.

items.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software

exploitedComponents.description: Components potentially exploited by this vulnerability.

derivedFrom.description: List of susceptibilities from which this vulnerability originated.

externalReferences.description: External references or documentation links related to the vulnerability.

attackStep.description: A reusable atomic action within an attack path.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attack step.

description.description: Detailed description of the attack step.

attackPattern.description: A reference to a STIX 2.1 Attack Pattern object, used to represent techniques from frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.

targetedVulnerabilities.description: List of vulnerability identifiers targeted by this attack step.

targetedAsset.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software
targetedAsset.description: A reference to a component in the system architecture that is targeted by this attack step.

attackPath.description: A potential sequence of actions a threat actor might take to achieve an objective.

id.description: Unique identifier for this attack path.

title.description: Title or short name of the attack path.

description.description: Detailed description of the attack path.

wheelOfAccessSector.description: A reference to a sector in a Wheel of Access that this attack path is associated with.

threatActors.description: Threat actors likely to use this attack path.

attackSteps.description: Linked references to attack steps comprising this path. Traverse starting from the item without a previousStepId.

previousStepId.description: Identifier of the previous step; omit for the first step in the path. If omitted, the first step in the path is assumed.

targetOutcomes.description: Desired outcomes or impacts of the attack path.

outcome.description: The end state or impact achieved through exploitation of an attack path.

title.description: Title or short name of the outcome.

impactMetric.description: A detailed, multi-faceted assessment of the impact of an outcome, linking to system architecture, missions, and capabilities.
A detailed, multi-faceted assessment of the impact of an outcome, linking to system architecture, missions, and capabilities.

impactedSystems.description: A list of specific systems affected by the outcome.

items.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software

missionImpact.description: A list of missions affected by the outcome and a description of the impact.

missionId.description: Identifier of the mission that is affected by the outcome.

degradation.description: Description of mission degradation, e.g., 'Reduced sensor accuracy', 'Complete loss of communication'.

disruptionDuration.description: Estimated duration of the disruption, e.g., '4 hours', '2 days'

impactedObjectives.description: A list of specific mission objectives that are impacted.

capabilityImpact.description: A list of system capabilities affected by the outcome.

capabilityId.description: Identifier of the capability that is affected by the outcome.

degradationDescription.description: A description of how the capability is degraded.

impactLevel.description: The level of impact on the capability.

compromisedDataImpact.description: A list of operational data elements that were compromised as part of the outcome.

operationalDataId.description: Identifier of the operational data that is affected by the outcome.

impactType.description: The type of impact on the operational data.

risk.description: An assessment of an attack path with likelihood, impact, and recommended mitigation strategies.

title.description: Title or short name of the risk.

attackPath.description: A reference to the attack path that this risk is associated with.

likelihoodScore.description: Score indicating how likely the attack is.

riskRating.description: Overall risk rating computed from likelihood and impact.

recommendedMitigations.description: Recommended courses of action to mitigate this risk.

wheelOfAccessSector.description: A specific sector within a Wheel of Access, which can contain child sectors to form a hierarchy.

id.description: Unique identifier for this wheel of access sector.

name.description: The name or title of the sector.

description.description: A detailed description of the sector.

children.description: Child sectors of this sector in a hierarchical structure.

wheelOfAccess.description: A hierarchical model, often used in intelligence, to represent different areas or categories of access or information that vulnerabilities can exploit.

id.description: Unique identifier for this wheel of access.

name.description: The name or title of the wheel of access.

description.description: A detailed description of the wheel of access.

version.description: The version of the wheel of access.

sectors.description: The root sectors of the Wheel of Access.

evaluationType.description: A type of evaluation, such as a penetration test or vulnerability scan.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation type.

name.description: The name or title of the evaluation type.

description.description: A detailed description of the evaluation type.

cyberEvaluation.description: An activity, such as a scan, test, or exercise, that assesses a target for weaknesses and identifies susceptibilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cyber evaluation.

name.description: The name or title of the evaluation activity, e.g., 'Q3 Network Penetration Test'.

evaluationTypeId.description: A reference to the type of evaluation that was performed.

conductedBy.description: The entities (people or organizations) that conducted the evaluation.

completionDate.description: The date and time when the evaluation was completed.

plannedDate.description: The date and time when the evaluation was planned.

scope.description: The systems or components that were the target of this evaluation.

items.$comment: References: SystemArchitecture.json - system, hardware, or software

findings.description: A list of susceptibilities that were discovered during this evaluation.

summary.description: A summary of the evaluation's purpose, scope, and overall results.

coursesOfAction.description: A collection of courses of action.

wheelsOfAccess.description: A collection of Wheels of Access.
